QF.id: SIA Logic Model for Social Programs_32

question.text: Antyodaya Seva Sangh (rural development NPO) has an activity 'Conduct 100 agricultural training camps in drought-prone Marathwada villages'. Which of the following is MOST appropriately placed in the Assumptions column of the LFM?

answer.text: Training materials are printed and staff are deployed
Beneficiary farmers are willing to attend and local administration cooperates with venue permissions; monsoon conditions do not prevent access to villages
The sun rises in the east

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook defines assumptions as external factors or conditions beyond the project team's direct control, and gives community willingness as a typical activity-level assumption. Option C captures realistic externalities (beneficiary willingness, administrative cooperation, weather access) consistent with that definition. The Trap: Option A describes inputs/internal readiness which the SE controls. Options B and D are trivially true constants and add no risk information. Note: A useful filter is whether the failure of the condition would materially affect activities or outputs.
